about_the_game:
EOPRISM is the educational puzzler that Millennial & Gen Z gamers wished they grew up with. You'll shoot solutions at your foes and obstacles as you quickly solve mathematical expressions in our 3 available game modes.

Story Mode is a short but re-playable adventure where no two runs are the same. Jump between quadrants, dodge tricky tangents, and foil The Ianfinite's (Villain) calculated plans with the future of Math. With procedurally generated equations, every playthrough is a fresh challenge in an endless loop of fast-paced problem-solving.

Practice Mode reinvents flash cards with a dynamic, customizable challenge. Train your wits from basic algebra to college calculus in an interactive, fast-paced way—no boring drills, just pure number-crunching action.

Challenge Mode (Coming Soon) brings fast-paced, split-screen action to local co-op. Team up for advanced mini-games, survive endless enemy waves, or battle it out in PvP to be crowned GCF (Greatest Calculator Fighter). Whether cooperating or competing, it’s math-driven mayhem at its finest.

EOPRISM will contain 5 Story Mode Missions, 1 Practice Mode Level, and 2 Challenge Modes. Sharpen your math skills and test your aim! Perfect your formulas and get your calculations ready for the real fight. No pressure, just pure number-crunching fun!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core Intel Core i5-3470 (4 * 3200) or equivalent / AMD FX-8350 (4 * 4000) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 ( 2048 MB) / Radeon R9 390X (8192 MB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core Intel Core i5-3470 (4 * 3200) or equivalent / AMD FX-8350 (4 * 4000) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 ( 2048 MB) / Radeon R9 390X (8192 MB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Join the fight in EOPRISM, a math shooter where you battle foes to stop Ianfinite’s Order of Operations! After the Day of Tessellation, this alien seeks control with the EOPRISM crystal. Solve puzzles, face calculator creatures, and restore balance before Ianfinite’s chaotic plans become limitless!
